items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I worked a few months with Benny, and the time I was with him, Slam Stewart was with him, and Red Norvo was with him same time I was with him.

ctx.x: Who could tell looking at Willie. And so -- and other times Harry James would be told he couldn't go on if he let Willie play. And so, Harry James would walk away and not play the date. But on the other hand, it was a convenience when you couldn't get food.

Oh, yeah. Barnett had a lot of problems over -- when we used to play with Barnett. We didn't go way down South. We'd be in places like West Virginia, you know. And he'd have a problem. I remember once with Benny Goodman, it was Teddy, Slam and myself, we had a problem in Providence in a hotel.
